title: Claude on Google Cloud: Monitoring and Securing Agents at Scale
description: Autonomous agents can now take actions across systems, make decisions without manual human review, and operate at scale. That creates real questions for security and IT teams: how do you enforce what an agent is allowed to do, and how do you trace and audit what it actually did. Join Anthropic and Google Cloud for a technical session on answering both in production , building Claude agents with Claude Agent SDK, applying guardrails at every tool call, and sending traces and audit events into Google Cloud Observability.

segments.text: Autonomous agents can now take actions across systems, make decisions without manual human review, and operate at scale. The session details foundational design principles, execution patterns, and operational integration requirements within the AI Agents, Backend/Infra domain.

segments.heading: Technical Capabilities, Tooling Integration, and Protocols
segments.text: Speakers analyze technical capabilities across Anthropic, Claude, Google Cloud. The architecture highlights reliable agent tool use, context window optimization, protocol standards, and seamless workflow interoperability.

segments.heading: Production Deployment, Verification, and Best Practices
segments.text: Production readiness demands robust evaluation harnesses, state validation, and error-handling loops. Teams implement systematic monitoring and guardrails to ensure reliability across repeated executions.

segments.heading: Organizational Impact, Scalability, and Industry Outlook
segments.text: Deploying agentic systems transforms developer and team workflows by automating high-friction tasks. Organizations scale safely by pairing automated tool orchestration with structured human review.
